title: Track issues
text: Catch issues mentioned in my sessions and keep their status current.
examples: Concurrent writes sometimes overwrite each other and lose updates.
The previously reported overwrite issue is now fixed.
The suspected memory leak was a false alarm; the measurements included the cache.

title: Track deferred work
text: Keep track of work we decide to leave for later, and update it when we finish it.
examples: Let's leave keyboard navigation for later; ship the mouse controls first.
We finished the migration we had postponed last week.
We agreed to defer retry support until after launch.

title: Keep architectural decisions
text: Keep our architectural decisions and why we made them.
examples: We decided to use a single SQLite database because each workspace runs on one machine.
Keep the parser separate from the UI so both the command line and desktop app can reuse it.
We replaced the queue with synchronous calls; the ordering guarantees matter more than throughput.

title: Track external API constraints
text: Track external API constraints and the workarounds we use, including changes to previously recorded constraints.
examples: The API returns at most 500 records, so we need pagination.
The provider now supports pagination; our previous workaround is unnecessary.
The external service rejects more than 100 requests per minute, so we must back off and retry.
